_about: Opportunities checked on their official websites on 2026-10-29 (starting from International_Opportunities_Directory.pdf). Only facts read on the official source are filled in; anything else is null and shown as 'Not specified'. Imported by `npm run db:seed` (upsert by slug).

scholarships.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027/28
scholarships.institution: University of Cambridge — Gates Cambridge Trust
scholarships.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom.
scholarships.qualifications: Applying for a full-time PhD (or part-time PhD), a full-time MLitt, or a one-year full-time postgraduate course at the University of Cambridge (some exceptions; MASt and most professional degrees such as MBA, EMBA, MFin and PGCE are excluded).
scholarships.tuition: University Composition Fee at the appropriate rate.
scholarships.stipend: Maintenance allowance for a single student: £23,152 for 12 months (2026-27 rate; pro rata for shorter courses).
scholarships.travel: One economy single airfare at the beginning and at the end of the course.
scholarships.insurance: Inbound visa costs and the Immigration Health Surcharge are covered.
scholarships.duration: Length of the course (PhD, MLitt or one-year postgraduate course).
scholarships.deadline_note: Two international deadlines, 11:59pm UK time: Tuesday 8 December 2026 or Wednesday 6 January 2027, depending on your course's University funding deadline. Check your course page. (US citizens resident in the US: 14 October 2026, already passed.)
scholarships.summary: Full-cost postgraduate scholarship at the University of Cambridge for outstanding applicants from any country outside the UK.
scholarships.description: Gates Cambridge is an international scholarship programme at the University of Cambridge for outstanding postgraduate students. Applications for entry in the academic year 2027/8 opened on 11 September 2026. You apply for the scholarship through the University's postgraduate application form for your chosen course.
scholarships.instructions: Apply to your Cambridge course through the University's postgraduate application portal and complete the Gates Cambridge section of the form before your course's deadline (8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027, 11:59pm UK time).

scholarships.title: WIPO Internship Programme
scholarships.eligible_nationalities: No nationality restriction stated on the official page. The travel reimbursement is for nationals of developing, least developed or transition countries residing in their home country.
scholarships.qualifications: Category I: bachelor's degree within the last 2 years, 3rd/4th-year undergraduate, or master's student who has not completed coursework/thesis. Category II: master's degree within the last 2 years, graduate student with coursework completed but thesis pending, or holder of a first advanced degree pursuing another degree.
scholarships.language_requirements: Professional (written and spoken) knowledge of English and/or French.
scholarships.stipend: 1,645 CHF per month (Category I) or 2,170 CHF per month (Category II).
scholarships.travel: Travel reimbursement up to 1,500 CHF for nationals of developing, least developed or transition countries residing in their home country.
scholarships.insurance: Full medical and professional accident insurance coverage.
scholarships.duration: 2 to 6 months (Category I) or 2 to 12 months (Category II).
scholarships.deadline_note: Rolling: the Internship Roster is generic and applications are shared with WIPO departments on a rolling basis. No fixed deadline is published on the official page.
scholarships.summary: Paid internship at the UN agency for intellectual property in Geneva for students and recent graduates.
scholarships.description: The WIPO Internship Programme gives students and recent graduates practical experience at the World Intellectual Property Organization in Geneva. Interns receive a monthly stipend, insurance coverage, visa assistance and leave entitlements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the WIPO Internship Roster on the WIPO careers portal (Taleo). Applications are shared with relevant areas at WIPO on a rolling basis.

scholarships.title: MEPI Tomorrow's Leaders Undergraduate Scholarship 2027–2028
scholarships.institution: American University of Beirut (AUB) and Lebanese American University (LAU)
scholarships.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of Algeria, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Libya, Morocco, Syria, Tunisia, West Bank or Palestinian students residing in a third country with legal residency status, or Yemen.
scholarships.qualifications: Current high school seniors or applicants who graduated from high school in 2026 (2025 graduates also accepted for Iraq, Libya, Syria, Palestinian students in third countries and Yemen). Strong academic credentials; current seniors must pass their leaving exam. Ability to start the undergraduate program in August 2027.
scholarships.language_requirements: TOEFL iBT 4.0 (new 1–6 scale) or 80 (old 0–120 scale), within two years of the program start date.
scholarships.deadline_note: Application deadline 18 November 2026 (timezone not stated on the official page). Existing TOEFL/IELTS results under two years old can be submitted with applications sent before 18 November 2026.
scholarships.summary: Undergraduate scholarships at AUB or LAU in Lebanon for final-year high school students and 2026 graduates from Algeria and other MENA countries.
scholarships.description: Tomorrow's Leaders, sponsored by the U.S. Department of State's Middle East Partnership Initiative, offers undergraduate scholarships and leadership training at partner universities in Lebanon. Applications for the 2027–2028 academic year opened in October 2026. Important: this track is only for current high school seniors and recent (2026) high school graduates, not for university students. The detailed financial benefits are not listed on the official pages we checked.
scholarships.instructions: Apply online through the official application form before 18 November 2026. Shortlisted candidates are invited to interviews in January 2027.

scholarships.title: FAO Regular Volunteer Programme
scholarships.institution: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
scholarships.qualifications: Completed secondary school education; aged 18 or older; able to work in an international multicultural environment with good communication and basic computer skills; appropriate residence or immigration status in the country of assignment; no family members employed by FAO.
scholarships.language_requirements: Working knowledge of at least one FAO official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish).
scholarships.stipend: None: FAO does not provide any remuneration to FAO Regular Volunteers.
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications respond to Calls for Expression of Interest published on the FAO careers portal; candidates not selected must re-apply to new calls. No fixed deadline on the official page.
scholarships.summary: Unpaid UN volunteer assignments with FAO for nationals of FAO member countries aged 18+.
scholarships.description: The FAO Regular Volunteer Programme lets individuals contribute to FAO's work under its Strategic Framework and the UN Sustainable Development Goals. It is an unpaid volunteer role.
scholarships.documents: Online application and a motivation letter.
scholarships.instructions: Apply to a published 'Call for Expression of Interest' on the FAO careers portal with an online application and a motivation letter. Only selected candidates are contacted.

scholarships.title: Hansen Leadership Institute 2027
scholarships.institution: Fred J. Hansen Foundation — University of San Diego
scholarships.deadline_note: International applicants: all materials, including references, by 11:55 PM Pacific Time on 15 January 2027. U.S. applicants: 15 March 2027.
scholarships.summary: Leadership programme in San Diego; the 2027 application is open.
scholarships.description: The Hansen Leadership Institute has launched its 2027 application. Program dates, age and education requirements and funded costs listed in third-party documents could not be confirmed on the official pages and must be checked before publication.

scholarships.title: Fulbright Visiting Scholar Program 2027–2028 (Lebanon)
scholarships.institution: U.S. host institutions — Fulbright Program (U.S. Department of State, administered by IIE)
scholarships.deadline_note: 1 December 2026 according to third-party listings; the official IIE portal requires login and could not be checked.
scholarships.summary: Research and lecturing grants in the U.S. for Lebanese scholars only — not open to Algerian applicants.
scholarships.description: Country-specific Fulbright competition for Lebanese faculty and researchers. Not open to Algerian applicants. Details must be confirmed on an official Fulbright Lebanon / U.S. Embassy Beirut page before any publication.
